description: This file implements native methods and functions related to managing video surfaces and native windows on Android, including surface change handling, surface clearing, and EGL/OpenGL cleanup.

classes.name: VideoSurfaceHolder
classes.description: Class managing the lifecycle and state of the video surface, including acquiring, releasing, and clearing the native video window.

methods.name: ClearNativeWindow
methods.description: Clears and resets the given native window by creating an EGL context, clearing the buffer, and cleaning up EGL resources.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceHolder::IsVideoSurfaceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a video surface is available and not currently held by another decoder.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceHolder::AcquireVideoSurface
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the video surface for use, returning the global video surface object if available.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceHolder::ReleaseVideoSurface
methods.description: Releases the video surface, marking it as available for others.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceHolder::GetVideoWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current size of the native video window.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceHolder::ClearVideoWindow
methods.description: Clears or resets the native video window, optionally resetting the surface based on internal flags.
